modules.name: Bookable Amenity
modules.description: Lets residents book amenities such as a hall for a date and time slot, subject to Society Manager approval.

requirements.title: Resident selects hall, date and time slot
requirements.description: A resident can pick a hall, a date and a time slot to request a booking.

requirements.title: Check slot availability
requirements.description: The system checks the chosen slot and shows it as unavailable when it is already booked.

requirements.title: Send booking request to Society Manager
requirements.description: Each booking request goes to the Society Manager for a decision.

requirements.title: Confirm booking and block slot on approval
requirements.description: When the request is approved, the booking is confirmed and the slot is blocked.

requirements.title: Resident can cancel a booking
requirements.description: A resident can cancel a booking before the cut-off time.

rules.title: Cancellation only before cut-off time
rules.description: A resident may cancel a booking only before the cut-off time.

rules.title: First approved request wins for a contested slot
rules.description: When two requests are made for one slot, the first one approved wins and the other is automatically rejected.
